### Fixed
- **The serving slice renders without an edge Gateway** (giantswarm/agent-platform#490): connectivity's `validateIngress` required a public Gateway for the muster `/` route and a `muster-direct`-consistent `components.agentgateway` toggle in every release, muster on or off — so the `<cluster>-agent-platform` slice (`examples/serving-slice.yaml`: no muster, its own models Gateway; agentgateway on where the target runs no controller) failed its render on gazelle with `no public Gateway for ingress.parentRefs`. Both checks now apply only while `components.muster` is on; the mode enum, the `agentgateway-direct` refusal, the "agentgateway-* mode needs the component" rule and the per-component muster-direct guards are unchanged. `tests/verify-serving-slice.py` renders the slice without any `ingress.parentRefs` and holds the guard for a release with muster on.
